_comment: Conditional required-field rules for a Redmine whose issue model differs from stock. Copy this file to required_fields.json (or set REDMINE_REQUIRED_FIELDS_FILE to its path). Each entry under by_tracker / by_category / by_status maps a name (matched case-insensitively) to a rule with `required` (field identifiers) and `defaults` (values to auto-fill when missing). `required` entries name standard issue fields by their API key (subject, priority_id, tracker_id, status_id, category_id, fixed_version_id, assigned_to_id, start_date, due_date, done_ratio, estimated_hours, ...) and custom fields by their display name (e.g. "Department"). Leave any dimension empty when not needed.
